scope: accepted ordered memory instructions only; unsupported/excluded clients require input census
semantic_instruction_rule: unique sector semantic id; -1=mixed; 0=unknown; no duplicated instructions
epoch_definition: kernel id in ordered replay; emission is a functional event, not service completion
retained_clean_definition: explicit internal event; classification SM/opcode/space/semantic are dirty producer provenance; eviction trigger null; no source instruction or lookup; valid mask retained; automatic policy disabled
line_hit_definition: l2_requests minus l2_line_miss (includes sector miss); sector hit excludes reserved
l1_legacy_definition: l1_requests includes read bypass as synthetic sector miss; actual_l1_lookups excludes all bypass
